title: Tenth Cavalry exhibitions and Joe teaching him to shoot
summary: In Kansas City in 1927 he saw old Tenth Cavalry soldiers put on shooting exhibitions, hitting targets while falling; Joe taught him to use a rifle.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: When I was at Kansas City in the 27 -- 1927, I didn't tell him -- I went out to see the old soldiers that my brother used to be with.
: No kidding.
A lot of old soldiers was there and they'd put on exhibitions.
: Yeah.
But they didn't allow them to have bullets.
: Oh, I see.
(Inaudible).
(Laughter.)
And the guys said (inaudible), they wouldn't give them
anymore guns (inaudible) bullets.
(Laughter.)
Really? No kidding.
They'd put on those exhibitions because anybody in the tenth cavalry on a horse could hit his target falling.
Honestly?
That's the way they'd practice. You ride the horse and you got to fall off the horse and you got to hit your target while you're falling.
Well, I never. Well, tell me --
(Inaudible) guys, if you shoot him off his horse, he'd kill you if he hadn't hit the ground.
Oh.
(Inaudible) tenth cavalry.
Well, you told me that your brother Joe taught you to shoot.
Yeah, he taught me to shoot.
You said he taught you to use a rifle?
Rifle, (inaudible), but he always (inaudible) learned to use a rifle better --
